common.offline: No internet. Check your connection and try again.

welcome.slide1Text: See nearby parking lots on the map and know the number of free spots in real time.
welcome.slide2Text: Pick a time, pay, and your spot is waiting. No queues, no hassle.
welcome.slide3Text: Get directions to the lot and show your QR code at the entrance.

login.title: ParkBor
login.subtitle: Find a spot and book it in one tap
login.terms: By signing in you agree to the terms

permissions.locationText: To show you the nearest parking lots.
permissions.notificationsText: To tell you about booking status and when time is running out.
permissions.denied: Permission denied. You can enable it in settings.

push.settingsHint: Reminders before your booking ends and changes to it.
push.settingsOff: Notifications are off on this device

vehicles.title: My vehicles
vehicles.emptyText: You need at least one vehicle to book a spot.
vehicles.plateHint: Latin letters and digits only. No spaces or dashes needed.
vehicles.removeText: The vehicle disappears from the list. Past bookings stay in your history.
vehicles.firstText: Adding your plate number now makes booking faster. You can also add it later.

validation.plateAscii: Use Latin letters only (Cyrillic is not allowed)
validation.plateLength: The plate must be 5 to 12 characters
validation.plateMix: The plate needs both letters and digits

error.vehicle_exists: A vehicle with this plate number is already added.

error.vehicle_in_use: This vehicle is in an active booking. You can delete it after the booking ends.

parking.invalid: This link is not valid. Pick a parking lot on the map.
parking.notCached: Details of this lot (name, address) are not available. Select it on the map again to see everything. Booking still works.
parking.slotsError: Could not load the number of free spots.
parking.moreLater: Photos and reviews are coming in later updates.

form.title: Book a spot

form.noSlots: No free spots of this type at that time.
form.priceIndicative: The price is indicative: the exact amount is fixed when the booking is created.
form.holdNote: The spot is held for 10 minutes. If it is not paid in time, the booking is cancelled.
form.retryHint: Tapping again sends the same request, so you will not get two bookings.
form.replayed: This booking was already created. Opening it.
form.invalidLot: The parking lot is not valid.
form.tashkentNote: All times are Tashkent time (UTC+5). Your device uses another time zone.

detail.title: Booking

qr.hint: Show this code to the operator at the entrance.
qr.error: Could not get the QR code.

qr.notYetValid: The QR code activates 2 hours before the start.
qr.unavailable: No QR code is available for this booking right now.
qr.label: Booking QR code
qr.secure: Security: screenshots are blocked and the code is stored only on your device.

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?

cancel.refundPartial: A refund of {{percent}}% of the amount paid is promised: {{amount}}. Timing depends on the provider and operator processing.
cancel.noPayment: No payment has been recorded yet. If the payment went through at the provider, it is returned automatically — check the status.

list.title: My bookings
list.emptyText: Pick a parking lot on the map and book a spot.
list.offline: No internet. Check your connection and try again.
list.skipped: Some bookings could not be shown.

error.booking_conflict: That time has just been taken. Choose another one.

error.qr_not_available: No QR code for this booking (only confirmed or active bookings have one).

error.vehicle_in_use: This vehicle is in an active booking.
error.vehicle_exists: A vehicle with this plate number is already added.
error.extend_unavailable: Extending a booking is not available yet.

error.period_invalid: The period is not valid: the end must be after the start.

error.start_in_past: The start time has already passed. Choose a new one.

error.vehicle_slot_mismatch: This spot type does not suit the vehicle type.

error.lock_timeout: The lot is busy right now. Try again in a few seconds.

error.payment_provider_unavailable: The selected payment method is not available right now. Choose another one or try again later.

refund.promised: This is the amount promised by the refund policy. The money has not been sent back yet; the refund depends on the payment provider and operator processing.
refund.pending: The refund is on its way. It can take a few days depending on the provider and your bank.
refund.manual: The refund is made manually, within 1–3 business days.
refund.failed: The refund failed. Please contact support.
refund.unknown: The refund status is unknown. Update the app or contact support.

provider.title: Payment method
provider.defaultHint: If you choose nothing, the default method is used.
provider.mustChoose: The default payment method is unavailable — choose another one.
provider.noneAvailable: No payment method is available right now. Try again later.

webview.title: Payment
webview.secure: Enter card details only on the payment provider's page. Where your device allows it, screenshots are disabled.
webview.exitBody: The booking stays held until the hold runs out. You can pay later from My bookings.

error.load: The payment page could not be loaded.
error.offline: No internet. Check the connection and try again.
error.ssl: The payment page's security certificate is not trusted. Payment was stopped.
error.timeout: The payment page took too long to load. Try again.
error.http: The payment page returned an error. Try again in a moment.
error.process: The payment window stopped unexpectedly. Try again.

webview.blocked: The bank page could not be opened. Check the payment status or try again.

unavailable.hold_over: The hold has expired — this booking can no longer be paid.
unavailable.invalid_url: The payment page address failed the security check and will not be opened. Please contact support.
unavailable.no_url: Payment for this booking is not available right now.
unavailable.not_pending: This booking is not waiting for payment.

result.title: Payment result
result.checkingHint: This can take a few seconds. We are waiting for the provider's confirmation.
result.paidHint: Your booking is confirmed. The QR code is on the booking page.
result.rejectedHint: The booking was cancelled or has expired. If money was charged, it is returned automatically (this can take a few days depending on the provider and operator).

result.failedHint: Check your internet connection and look at the status in My bookings.
result.holdLapsed: The hold has expired. Refreshing the status from the server…

result.already_checked_in: The car is already inside. This scan admitted nobody — open by hand or check.
result.deferred: Car released. The payment stays as a debt
result.still_due: The server still shows a debt. The owner will review it
result.needs_review: Car released. The owner or an admin will settle the debt
result.lost: The result was not shown (the screen was left). The server may have done it — check the car or scan the code again.
result.unknown: Unknown result. Check the car’s state by hand

reason.already_used: This code has already been used.
reason.plate_mismatch: The plate does not match the booking. Check the plate.
reason.booking_not_paid: The booking is not paid yet.

reason.slot_out_of_service: The slot is out of service.
reason.not_checked_in: This car was not checked in.
reason.scan_locked: Too many bad scans: entry is locked for a while. Exit still works.
reason.lock_timeout: The lot is busy. Try again.
reason.serialization_retry: The lot is busy. Try again.
reason.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
reason.slot_reserved_soon: This slot is booked very soon (a booking starts within 15 minutes). Choose another.

reason.vehicle_slot_mismatch: The vehicle type does not fit this slot type.
reason.walk_in_rate_limited: Too many walk-in attempts this hour. Try again later.
reason.slot_in_use: A car is on the slot: its status cannot be changed.

reason.force_not_allowed: Forcing is allowed for the owner or an admin only.

reason.network: No internet or the server is not responding.
reason.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
reason.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
reason.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
reason.unavailable: The service is busy. Try again shortly.
reason.contract: The server’s answer was not understood, but the action may have been done. Check the car’s state by hand.
reason.needs_review: This debt waits for the owner’s or an admin’s review. Do not take cash.

reason.qr_not_available: No code is available for this booking now (it is finished or not active).

lot.pending_review: The lot is under review: only exit works (entry, walk-in and slot status are off).
lot.inactive: The lot is not active: only exit works.

home.noLots: No lot is assigned to you
home.noLotsHint: Enter the invite code from the owner.
home.scanHint: Check cars in and out by code
home.walkInHint: Register a car and release it by hand

join.linkHint: Enter the invite code from the owner

join.intro: Enter the 26-character code from the lot owner. It works once.

join.successText: You are assigned to {{lot}}. The “Operator” tab now appears in the bottom menu.
